summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which constructs a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<arch>.zip`, downloads the Bun runtime archive for the installer's platform/architecture, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a 727KB obfuscated sibling script `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, rotated string arrays, per-call string maps). The advertised entry point `jest-preset.js` unconditionally throws `Error('Use @ornikar/jest-config-react-native/web instead')`, so the package has no functional jest configuration — the preinstall dropper is the only real code path. The declared purpose (a jest preset) does not match the shipped behavior, and the alternate-runtime execution bypasses tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code. Package name resembles the legitimate `@ornikar` org's shared configs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
